findings.statement: with sequential keys promotion cuts device bytes to at most 0.5x the merge's
findings.detail:
device bytes 9.2 MB with promotion against 9.2 with the merge (1.000x) at 16 MB \
             seals; disk 3.3 against 3.3 MB, partitions 1 against 1; merge phase \
             0.010s against 0.010s. A piece whose keys lie above the partition's last key \
             becomes a partition by rename, and the data is written once to the WAL and once \
             to its seal

findings.statement: with sequential keys promotion lifts ingest-to-routed by at least 1.3x
findings.detail:
546457 ops/s with promotion against 547295 with the merge (promote vs merge: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 0.998, p=0.5309) -- within noise, not a result); seal 0.011s against \
             0.011s, merge 0.010s against 0.010s, commit 0.011s against 0.010s

findings.statement: with uniform keys promotion changes nothing: device bytes within 1.05x and ingest a tie
findings.detail:
device bytes 9.2 MB with promotion against 9.2 without (1.000x); ingest 534264 \
             against 537964 ops/s (promote vs merge: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 0.993, p=1.0000) -- within noise, not a result); partitions 1 against 1. Every piece of a uniform \
             load spans the whole key space, so nothing qualifies

findings.statement: reads after the drain do not differ with promotion under either key order
findings.detail:
uniform: 119 ns per read with promotion against 119 (promote vs merge: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 1.011, p=0.8102) -- within noise, not a result); sequential: 116 \
             against 125 (promote vs merge: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 0.937, p=0.5752) -- within noise, not a result). Promoted pieces are partitions, fence-routed, with no Bloom to \
             consult; there are more of them after an ordered load, and the fence search is a \
             binary search

notes: four arms interleaved in one process, fresh store per rep, at 16 MB seals over 64 MB partitions with the drain inside the window. Two key orders: uniform (a random permutation of the ids) and sequential (the ids in order, the shape of a log). Promotion off (every due range merges) and on (pieces whose keys lie above the partition's last key become partitions by rename). Device and disk bytes, phases, partitions, and point reads after the drain
predictions registered in promote-plan.md before the run
